text: If you are in the 22% federal tax bracket, all of your income is taxed at 22%.

room.label: U.S. taxpayers
room.questionWording: If you are in the 22% tax bracket, how much of your income is taxed at 22%: just some of it, or all of it?
room.note: VERIFY: split 34 all / 48 just some / 18 don't know is from two secondary sources. Field dates (early 2024) and n (2,064 completed vs 2,700+ reported) must be read from the report PDF (taxfoundation.org FF855). Confirm whether PPP's sample was opt-in.

truthSource.label: IRS, Federal income tax rates and brackets
truthSource.oneLine: Each rate applies only to the slice of income inside its bracket, so moving into a higher bracket never raises the tax on the income below it.
